snippet.title: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus! Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus now on steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5329940/SCROLLS_Tidy_up_the_Library_of_Olympus/

Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or co-op!
